mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, John Ehlers' published Reflex oscillator crossing zero on completed four-hour BTC auctions identifies a standardized departure from the zero-lag linear path; follow the new curvature direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long on a strict nonpositive-to-positive Reflex crossing; short on a strict nonnegative-to-negative crossing
mechanism.why_distinct: Reflex SuperSmooths close, compares its prior Length observations with the straight line joining current and Length-lag filtered values, averages the path residual, and recursively standardizes it. It is not TrendFlex, a fast/slow crossover, raw return or price level, fixed-threshold reentry, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: Reflex was designed to react promptly to significant reversals and the crossing must occur while completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation ranks in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: standardized zero-lag path-residual curvature crossings are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.reflex: published period-20 Reflex of completed close
features.path_residual: Slope=(Filt[Length]-Filt)/Length; Sum is the mean of (Filt+count*Slope)-Filt[count] for count one through Length
features.event: strict finite Reflex zero crossing relative to the immediately prior valid decision
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.recursive_reset: invalid completed four-hour bars reset filter and MS state; initialize the first three filtered values to close and MS to zero; require at least Length+1 uninterrupted observations and finite current/prior Reflex values

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: published Ehlers period-20 Reflex zero crossing under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no length, recursion, initialization, normalization, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: John F. Ehlers, Reflex: A New Zero-Lag Indicator, TASC February 2020
external_basis.fixed_definition: Length=20; SuperSmoother critical period=.5*Length; Slope=(Filt[Length]-Filt)/Length; Sum=mean over count 1..Length of (Filt+count*Slope)-Filt[count]; MS=.04*Sum^2+.96*MS[1]; Reflex=Sum/sqrt(MS); zero reference
external_basis.selection_use: published default, recursions, normalization, and zero reference only; no incidence or outcomes
